# Project plan

## Start-up phase

babelrd gets a public GitHub repository and r-universe builds, MIT licensed, with a milestone board and an ISC note per milestone. Drafted translations take whatever license [rdlocal #50](https://github.com/eliocamp/rdlocal/issues/50) settles on.

## Technical delivery

| # | Milestone | Deliverable | Date | Hours | USD |
|:--|:--------|:--------------------------------------------|:----------|----:|-----:|
| M1 | Draft and check (DeepL) | `draft()`, `check()` and `estimate()`, run on a full MASS module, Elio's base.es and my [demo package](https://github.com/adit-0132/multilingual-docs) (all three `\Sexpr` stages) | 2027-02-15 | 50 | 2,000 |
| M2 | PO / Weblate bridge | `to_po()` / `from_po()`, building on the approach in Ashish Tiwari's sprint #17 proof of concept; a MASS.es round trip; Weblate guide | 2027-04-15 | 40 | 1,600 |
| M3 | Glossary and providers | r-devel/glossary; Microsoft and Google backends; optional [ellmer](https://ellmer.tidyverse.org/) LLM backend, including local Ollama | 2027-05-31 | 30 | 1,200 |
| M4 | MASS pilot and docs | MASS.es draft (155 topics) published with its `check()` report and review sheet; edit rates for topics volunteers review by then (aim: 20); vignettes | 2027-06-30 | 20 | 800 |
| | **Total** | | | **140** | **5,600** |

## Other aspects

I'll write start and delivery posts for the R Consortium blog, share milestone updates in the Multilingual Documentation WG and on Mastodon, and submit a talk to LatinR or useR! 2027.

## Budget & funding plan

All labour, at $40/h; the amounts per milestone are in the table above. API costs fall on the drafting team's own key. M1 alone gives translators a draft tool, and M1 plus M2 give the whole draft and review loop.
